title: seed_requirements
description: Index of seed document hashes used by the freshness checker to detect when seeds have changed since a spec was last written.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI identifying this as a seed requirements index.

seeds.description: Map of seed_id to hash record. Keyed by seed_id (not a list).

source_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the seed file at index time.

indexed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this seed was indexed.
